notes: The certificate name and the Team ID are public: both are readable from any signed artifact with `codesign -dvv`.

`notaryKeychainProfile` is a local alias for credentials stored in the operator's login keychain by `xcrun notarytool store-credentials`. No credential, private key or secret of any kind belongs in this file or anywhere in this repository.

Chrome for Testing ships ad-hoc/linker-signed (`codesign -dvv` reports `flags=0x20002(adhoc,linker-signed)`, `TeamIdentifier=not set`) — there is no upstream Developer ID signature to preserve, so every Mach-O in the package is re-signed under the identity above.

An entitlement may only appear here together with a `reasons` entry naming the component and the observed failure that forced it. Every component starts with none; a grant is added when a measurement demands it and removed as soon as it does not.

reasons.com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit: Measured 2026-07-26. Signed with the hardened runtime and no entitlements, 'Google Chrome for Testing Helper (Renderer)' aborts with EXC_BREAKPOINT/SIGTRAP as soon as a page is created, and Playwright reports 'TargetClosedError: Browser.new_page: Target page, context or browser has been closed'; the same binary signed ad-hoc runs the identical probe. V8 needs write-then-execute pages via MAP_JIT and the hardened runtime denies them without this. Granting only this key is enough: com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory was NOT required and is deliberately not granted.

reasons.com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit: Measured 2026-07-26 with a control group. The packaged Node runtime, whole directory copied so its sibling dylibs stayed intact, signed ad-hoc with --options runtime and no entitlements exits 133 with no output; V8 aborts inside Isolate::Init ('Failed to reserve virtual memory for CodeRange', EXC_BREAKPOINT/SIGTRAP). The identical binary signed with --options runtime plus this key exits 0 and evaluates the expression. V8 needs write-then-execute pages via MAP_JIT and the hardened runtime denies them without this. Granting only this key is enough: com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory was NOT required and is deliberately not granted. Real consequence of the omission: the shipped package could open no browser (every RPA path) and render no brand-motion video, while every gate stayed green.
